scoring_justification: Full recompute is infeasible because DFT calculations are computationally heavy and cannot be rerun in the verifier sandbox; the checker uses structural trends (monotonic, sign) and numeric tolerances against paper-reported reference values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference G-band frequencies, K-point crossing energies, and intercalation voltages for five stoichiometries extracted from the paper's Figures 3,4,5a and the provided reference solve.sh (which encodes the paper's DFT results).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figures 3 (phonon dispersions G-band position), 4 (electronic band structures K-point crossing), 5a (voltage profile). Values were read from the figures and used as reference in the hidden oracle solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from figures and cross-checked with the reference oracle values derived from the same figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values directly trace to the paper's reported computational results, providing authoritative gold for verification.

k_point_crossing_energy_eV.description: Energy of the highest occupied band at the K-point relative to the Fermi level (positive means crossing above Fermi, negative below)

intercalation_voltage_V.description: Average intercalation voltage for the step from the previous Na content; null for graphite_AB

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the computed DFT phonon, electronic, and voltage properties for the series of Na-intercalated graphitic model structures. The checker will compare each stoichiometry's values against hidden gold trends and tolerances to verify reproduction of the key computational findings.

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform full DFT calculations; no intermediate DFT outputs are scored, only this final JSON file. The checker verifies that G-band frequency decreases monotonically with Na content, K-point crossing is above Fermi for low Na and below for high Na, and intercalation voltages are positive up to NaC24 and negative beyond. Tolerances are hidden.

steps.description: Check G-band frequency monotonic decrease and values within tolerance
Check K-point crossing energy sign pattern and values within tolerance
Check intercalation voltage sign pattern and magnitude trend
